keys.swarm.aura_halo_of_light_desc: A halo over your head heals you over time, and its light slowly burns monsters standing in it.
keys.swarm.aura_halo_of_light_ten: Divine Aura: the light fills the screen.
keys.swarm.aura_song_notes_desc: Musical notes float out on a wavy line; a monster they hit is charmed and fights the horde for a while. The notes do not affect bosses.
keys.swarm.aura_song_notes_ten: Symphony: notes spiral out in every direction.
